import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List of source CSV file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/test_0.csv"
        # Add more source files here if needed
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Read source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype=str)  # Read all columns as string
        # Normalize user_id to lowercase to match target style
        if 'user_id' in df.columns:
            df['user_id'] = df['user_id'].str.lower()
        # Ensure columns are in target schema order
        df = df[['user_id', 'email', 'geo']]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
